summary: xAI launched Grok 4.5, a new flagship model trained on tens of thousands of NVIDIA GB300 GPUs, positioned as its strongest model for coding, agentic tasks and knowledge work, with stated benchmark results, token-efficiency figures and new pricing.

mechanisms.reason: The model was trained on a large disclosed GPU fleet for a large-scale run, indicating continued training compute demand.
mechanisms.quote: Grok 4.5 was trained across tens of thousands of NVIDIA GB300 GPUs, with training and stability techniques designed for large-scale runs.

mechanisms.reason: The model is stated to resolve tasks using far fewer output tokens than a comparable leading model, a quantified reduction in work per task.
mechanisms.quote: ok 4.5 resolves tasks with 15,954 output tokens on average, about 4.2× fewer than Opus 4.8 (max) at 67,020 E

mechanisms.reason: The lab positions this as its strongest model ever, exceeding comparable leading models across a range of coding and agentic benchmarks.
mechanisms.quote: It's our strongest model ever and was trained alongside Cursor .

categories.reason: The training run is stated to use tens of thousands of NVIDIA GPUs, reflecting continued demand for merchant accelerators.
categories.quote: Grok 4.5 was trained across tens of thousands of NVIDIA GB300 GPUs

practices.reason: A newly released model with stated gains in coding/agentic benchmark performance and token cost efficiency would change which model an engineering team defaults to for coding and agent workloads.
practices.quote: ok 4.5 is priced at $2 per million input tokens and $6 per million output tokens. The model also achieves roughly 2x the token efficiency of comparable leading models, solving tasks in under half the number of steps. O

practices.reason: The release names specific third-party-run benchmarks (DeepSWE, SWE Marathon, Terminal Bench, SWE Bench Pro) an engineering team could examine or replicate to assess coding/agentic reliability.
practices.quote: DeepSWE 1.0 (eval created by Datacurve, run with each model provider’s harnesses by AA)

notable_reason: A frontier-positioned model launch with disclosed training-compute scale, quantified token-efficiency gains, and new pricing is directly relevant to anyone tracking model economics and hardware demand.
